questions.q:
Integer i, s
Set s = 0
for(i = 1; i <= 5; i = i + 1)
  s = s + i * i
end for
Print s

Integer a, b
Set a = 4, b = 8
b = b ^ a
a = a ^ b
Print a + b

Integer n, c
Set n = 45, c = 0
while(n > 0)
  if(n MOD 2 == 0)
    c = c + 1
  end if
  n = n / 2
end while
Print c

Integer i, j, c
Set c = 0
for(i = 1; i <= 3; i = i + 1)
  for(j = 1; j <= i; j = j + 1)
    c = c + 1
  end for
end for
Print c

Integer a, b
Set a = 12, b = 10
Print (a & b) + (a | b)

Integer fun(Integer x)
  return x * x + 2 * x + 1
End function
Print fun(4)

Integer marks
Set marks = 72
if(marks >= 90)
  Print 1
else if(marks >= 75)
  Print 2
else if(marks >= 60)
  Print 3
else
  Print 4
end if

Integer a
Set a = 5
a = a << 3
a = a >> 1
Print a

Integer a, b
Set a = 5
b = a++ + ++a
Print b

Integer fact(Integer n)
  if(n <= 1)
    return 1
  end if
  return n * fact(n - 1)
End function
Print fact(4)
